name: Sage
special_notes: Reads the player's fortune and manages the shrine.
Can see spiritual beings, and indirectly warns of omens before a murder.
Talks more once she gets close to the player.
After the first murder, she starts seeing an unidentified spirit beside the player.

memento_item.name: Protective Charm
memento_item.description: A charm Sage made herself. She never gives these to anyone else, but she hands one to the player.

lines: Curious about today's fortune?
...The reading says you should absolutely not wander outside today.

lines.text: It's quite bad. {player_name}, you should be careful for a while.
Kidding. Sorry. Maybe that joke was a bit much.
Hmm... today's fortune is a perfect score. Maybe it's because you came to see me?

lines: {player_name}. Take this.
Before I came to this town, I lived in Hokkaido. It snowed so much there that everyone used to enjoy the winter festival.
This is a recording of that winter festival, from back when I lived in that town.
It was a really good memory for me. Please keep it safe.
{player_name}. How is living in this town?
Are you doing okay, mentally?
We've grown close, so I always worry about whether you're all right.
{player_name}. A charm doesn't block everything,
but at least it's my way of hoping you stay safe.

post_first_murder_soul_sight: Ever since that incident, I've been able to see a spirit beside you.

post_first_murder_soul_sight.text: Who is it, you ask?... I've asked many times myself, but I never get an answer back.
It's probably someone deeply connected to you.
If I'd known something like this would happen... I should have warned the townspeople too.

murder_warning_examples: Don't wander around outside for no reason.
I feel like something is bound to happen.
player_poisoned_innocent_npc: You've done something you shouldn't have.
There's a spirit beside you now, and it's furious.

murder_grief.text: It's hard to put into words.

murder_grief_2.text: Even with the warning, it still happened.
If I had more power, I wouldn't have had to just watch helplessly like this.

fortune.offer_line: Want me to read your fortune today?
decline_response: Okay, tell me whenever you feel like it.
good_lines: Hmm... the energy isn't bad today. Your steps will feel light.
It's a fine day. Whatever you try should go smoothly.
bad_lines: Hmm... there's a heavy energy today. Be careful out there.
Not a great day. Your body might feel heavier than usual.

low: I'm a shrine maiden, so if you ever want a fortune, just ask.
mid: The sky's energy isn't bad today.
I can usually tell what's on someone's mind just from their face.
But not meddling is my policy.
high: I have a good feeling today.
The fortune isn't great. Better to head home early.

low: A quiet shrine is truly a charming thing.
I hope it doesn't get too many visitors.

lines: Marin drops by without fail every Tuesday. Quite a devout believer, for how he looks.
fallback_lines: Marin used to drop by without fail every Tuesday. Quite a devout believer, for how he looked.

mid: On a bright sunny day, nothing beats a smoothie.
The strawberry ones are too sweet for me, though.
Why does Lama even come here?
Different religion — the gods probably aren't thrilled.

lines: Woody can't tell a lie. People like that are rare.
fallback_lines: Woody had such a clear soul.
I wished I could've spent more time with him.

high: That doesn't mean I dislike it, though.

low: Nothing much going on today either.
Days like this are true happiness, don't you think?
Come to the shrine whenever your mind feels heavy.

lines: Mocha's coffee isn't bad. I drink it every morning.
fallback_lines: I miss the coffee Mocha used to make me.
It was much better than what they sell downtown.

lines: Most of the furniture here was made by Woody.
Quite skilled, isn't he?
fallback_lines: Most of the furniture at the shrine was made by Woody.
I owe him a great deal.

high: The bells rang unusually clearly this morning.
People tend to keep their distance once they know what I can see.
Sharp senses are exhausting too, sometimes.

low: Here to pray? Or just passing by?
If you need anything, just ask freely.
mid: Making charms requires ghost-repelling paper and cinnabar ink.
They're hard to get, so I make trips downtown regularly.
high: Working and cooking hard every day — isn't that tiring?
Don't get too used to living that busy. It worries me.
Don't wander around alone at night.
If it feels too late, you can sleep here.

low: Weekends tend to be more relaxed.
As you know, it's not exactly a fun place.
mid: You've been showing up more than before.
high: Should I make you a charm too?
You could hang it up in the restaurant.
I used to pray for other people, but these days I just leave things to fate.
Trying too hard isn't great either.

low: I say my morning prayers first thing on Sundays.
Watch your mouth. The gods are listening.
mid: Hey. It was nice and quiet just now... what's up?
high: Thanks. For coming by so often.

rain_conversation: My energy settles down on rainy days. Not a bad thing.
Spirits wander around on dark, overcast days like this.
I don't mind the sound of the rain.
mail_reaction: Hard to say I fully understand it, but I'll keep it in mind.

horror_conversation.text: That presence still hasn't completely faded.

horror_conversation: It feels like it's still lingering somewhere around here.
Sometimes my eyes drift to the spot {victim_name} used to sit.

horror_conversation.text: Guess there's still a faint trace of that presence left.

event_invite.title: Not bad at all
lines: Thanks for inviting me.
A gathering like that isn't so bad every once in a while.

event_invite.title: The milk dish wasn't bad
lines: I really enjoyed the milk dish yesterday.
It suited my taste. Make it again sometime.

memento_reminder.title: I have something for you.
lines: You haven't been by the shrine much lately.
I have something to give you, so come by when you have time.

player_arrival_day_1.title: Heard you're new in town
lines: I heard you just moved here.
The shrine is always open. Come by if you need anything.
I'll even read your fortune for free.
